constraints.description: The distributional public-service equity schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: chief equity officer and city performance director
decision_question: When should access repairs, outreach, translation, staffing, audits, and follow-up milestones occur?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The distributional public-service equity schedule must respect declared labor, access, sequencing, notice, and completion windows.
independence_key.decision_object: cross-agency equity remediation and review schedule
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for cross-agency equity remediation and review schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: rights-, severity-, dependency-, capacity-, and accountability scheduling
independence_key.primary_outcome: person-days below verified minimum service standards

intended_claim: A versioned schedule design for comparing declared alternatives affecting cross-agency equity remediation and review schedule, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: person-days below verified minimum service standards
distributional gap in person-days below verified minimum service standards
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call scheduled remediation implemented, compliant, accepted, or effective.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for cross-agency equity remediation and review schedule passes documented checks for effective dates, time zones, calendars, lead times, completion semantics, and update cadence.

title: Schedule equity remediation and service reviews
transportability_risks: Rights, demographics, service rules, need measurement, geography, and reporting access differ.
Administrative denominators may omit eligible or underserved populations.
